description: Four years ago, Democrat Gretchen Driskell, then mayor of Saline, won election to the state House by defeating a Republican incumbent on GOP turf. She set out on a similar task this year, challenging Republican incumbent Tim Walberg for Michigan's 7th Congressional District seat. Walberg, R-Tipton, proved he was up to the challenge, defeating Driskell in the Nov. 8 election.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY WALBERG FOR CONGRESS
title: Walberg Defeats Driskell to Retain Michigan's 7th Congressional District | Tim Walberg for Congress
